item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
• Uninstall, under Settings and Help: moves the app to the Trash and removes its settings, cache, launch-at-login entry, Accessibility permission and Jev key. Your saved layouts stay or go, as you choose.
  • A saved Jev key can now be removed under Settings.
  • Renaming a profile to a name another profile already has is refused.
